Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def analyze(k):
    gi,go=G[k+' input'],G[k+' output']
    h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0]); nl=w//2
    # collect left blocks (between horizontal zero separators, using left nl cols)
    sep=[i for i in range(h) if all(x==0 for x in gi[i])]
    grps=[];st=0
    for s in sep+[h]:
        if s>st: grps.append(list(range(st,s))); st=s+1
    out=[]
    for gs in grps:
        L=[[gi[r][c] for c in range(nl)] for r in gs]
        R=[[gi[r][w-nl+c] for c in range(nl)] for r in gs]
        O=[[go[r][c] for c in range(nl)] for r in gs]
        col={v for row in R for v in row if v!=0}
        print(k,'group',gs[:3],'left:',L,'\nright:',R,'\nout:',O,'\ncolor:',col)
analyze('Demo pair 1'); analyze('Demo pair 2')

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); nl=w//2; bg=g[0][0]
    sep=[i for i in range(h) if all(v==bg for v in g[i][:nl]) and all(v==0 for v in g[i][nl:])]
    res=[]; prev=-1
    # groups of consecutive non-separator rows
    for i in [0]+sep+[h]:
        start=i
        while start<h:
            pass
        grp=list(range(start,i))
        out_rows=[]
        HL=[[g[r][c] for c in range(nl)] for r in grp]
        HR=[[g[r][c] for c in range(nl,w-nl)] for r in grp]   # right panel columns nl..2nl-1? no: width=2*nl, right half = nl..w-1 -> w-nl cols starting at nl
        HR=[[g[r][c] for c in range(nl,w)] for r in grp]
        nz=[(r,c,g[r][nl+c]) for r in range(len(HR)) for c in range(nl) if HR[r][c]!=0]
        cols={v for _,_,v in nz}
        col=next(iter(cols))
        rs=[r for r,c,v in nz]; cs=[c for r,c,v in nz]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        shape=[[1 if HR[rr+grp[0]][cc] else 0 for cc in range(c0,c1+1)] for rr in range(r0,r1+1)]
        bh=[[HL[r][c]==0 for c in range(nl)] for r in grp]
        height,width_=len(shape),len(shape[0])
        best=None
        for tr in range(-height+1,len(bh)-height):
            for tc in range(-width_+1,nl-width_):
                ok=True
                for di in range(height):
                    for dj in range(width_):
                        y,x=tr+di,tc+dj
                        if not(0<=y<len(bh) and 0<=x<nl) or bh[y][x]: ok=False; break
                    if not ok: break
                if ok:
                    cnt=sum(1 for di in range(height) for dj in range(width_) if shape[di][dj] and bh[tr+di][tc+dj])
                    if best is None or cnt>best[0]: best=(cnt,tr,tc)
        fill=[row[:] for row in HL]
        if best and best[0]>0:
            cnt,tr,tc=best
            for di in range(height):
                for dj in range(width_):
                    if shape[di][dj]:
                        y,x=tr+di,tc+dj
                        if 0<=y<len(fill) and 0<=x<nl: fill[y][x]=col
        res.append(fill)
        start=i

    return res

from collections import defaultdict
def f(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    sep=[c for c in range(W) if all(g[r][c]==0 for r in range(H))][0]
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    # start with zeros, paint left region as background
    bg=g[0][0]
    for c in range(sep):
        for r in range(H): out[r][c]=bg
    cells=defaultdict(list)
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(sep+1,W):
            v=g[r][c]
            if v!=0: cells[v].append((r,c))
    for v,cs in sorted(cells.items()):
        rs=[r for r,_ in cs]; cc=[c-sep for _,c in cs]
        top,bot=min(rs),max(rs); lft=min(cc); rgt=max(cc)
        for r,c in cs: out[r][c-sep]=v
    return out

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); gi=G['Demo pair 2 input']; go=G['Demo pair 2 output']
ti=G['Test input']

def f(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    sep=[c for c in range(W) if all(g[r][c]==0 for r in range(H))][0]
    nbg=g[0][0]
    rows_nz=[r for r in range(H) if any(g[r][c]!=0 for c in range(sep+1,W))]
    bs=[]; cur=rows_nz[:1]; prev=cur[0]
    for r in rows_nz[1:]:
        if r==prev+1: cur.append(r)
        else: bs.append(cur); cur=[r]; prev=r
    bs.append(cur)
    # reversed band order for coloring; mask = left zeros of current band rows
    out=[[nbg]*sep for _ in range(H)]
    for i,b in enumerate(bs[::-1]):   # iterate bands bottom->top, painting with that band's color
        col=Counter(g[r][c] for r in b for c in range(sep+1,W) if g[r][c]!=0).most_common(1)[0][0]
        for rr in b:
            for c in range(sep):
                if g[rr][c]==0: out[rr][c]=col
    return out
print(f(gi)==go)
pred=f(ti)
print(json.dumps(pred))
